title: Say pnpm once instead of rediscovering it
rationale: The same project keeps being probed for its package manager: three turns show a failed `npm test` followed by a successful `pnpm test`. One line in the prompt removes the discovery step from every future turn.
prompt: This repository uses pnpm. Run `pnpm test` and `pnpm build`. `npm` and `yarn` are not installed here.
